name: Multi-Agent Demo
description: Four-step workflow spanning all four supported agents with cross-agent handoffs: claude-code → opencode → codex → gemini

steps.description: Analyze the task and write a structured plan to ./plan.md. When the plan is complete, call the handoff tool to route to the implementation step.

edges.intent: Hand off to the opencode implementation step once the plan is written and approved

steps.description: Read ./plan.md and implement the described solution. Write results to ./output.md. Call handoff to route to code review when done.

edges.intent: Hand off to the codex review step once implementation is complete

steps.description: Review ./output.md for correctness and completeness. Append review notes to ./review.md. Call handoff to route to the summary step when done.

edges.intent: Hand off to the gemini summary step once the review is written

steps.description: Read ./plan.md, ./output.md, and ./review.md. Write a concise final summary to ./summary.md. Call finish when done.
